title: Design Inspector
purpose: Two-column layout for inspecting web pages: live page on left, captured element details on right
acceptance: shall display address bar to load a web page
shall show iframe with the requested page
shall support Pick Element mode to click and capture element details
shall show captured element's HTML, computed styles, and screenshot
shall allow leaving comments on captured elements
shall allow copying element details to clipboard
shall display any notices or errors from page inspection
